test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is appointed as the deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeshwar Rao.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajeshwar Rao**

 
 
• **​**P. V. Rajeshwar Rao was an **Indian politician.**
 
• He was a **member of parliament.**
 
• He represented Andhra Pradesh in the Lok Sabha, as a member of the** Indian National Congress.**
 
• Rajeshwar Rao took over as the **Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India** on **October 9, 2020.**
 
• Shri Rao was** Executive Director** of the** Reserve Bank** before being elevated to the post of Deputy Governor.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hasmukh Adhia**

 
 
• **​**Hasmukh Adhia is an** Indian Banker** and a **civil servant.**
 
• He is the key person behind the roll-out of the Goods and Services Tax & Demonetization scheme.
 
• He is an Indian Administrative Service** (IAS) officer of the 1981 Gujarat** cadre batch.
 
• He is the present **Non-Executive Chairman of Bank of Baroda.**
 
 
 
• **Subhash Chandra Garg**
 
 
• **​**Subhash Chandra Garg is a **1983 batch IAS officer** of the Rajasthan cadre.
 
• He served as Economic Affairs Secretary and Finance Secretary of India.
 
• He has also served as an** executive director of the World Bank.**
 
 
 
• **Ashok Lavasa**
 
 
• Ashok Lavasa is a retired** 1980 batch IAS officer** of the **Haryana cadre.**
 
• He was one of the two Election Commissioners of India.
 
• He has been appointed as the **Vice President **of the **Asian Development Bank (ADB).**
 
 

5b:T
